notes.title: Multilingual update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I have just released another small update to Chapter 10. I said small, but it was actually a lot of work 😅 There are two major changes:[/p][p][/p][p]1) I made a lot of text fixes to the English version of the game. [b]MagicMan753[/b] collected hundreds of fixes and improvements, for which I am eternally grateful ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]2) I added translations in nine languages:[/p][list][*][p]German (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]French (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Italian (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazil) (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Czech[/p][/*][*][p] Polish (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish (AI)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Most of these were created using AI. Let me explain. I was always a firm believer in manual translations and disliked machine translations. However, two things have recently changed my mind. Firstly, several people told me independently that any translation is better than no translation if you don't understand English well enough to enjoy the game. Secondly, advances in AI have made it possible to create translations that take larger contexts into account, yielding much better results than "old school" machine translators.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, AI translation is more flexible, because I can e.g. translate a new chapter in a matter of hours. And last but not least, it's significantly less expensive.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, the result is not perfect. I'm well aware of that. There are inconsistencies, and some of the translations will undoubtedly sound strange to a native speaker. I consider this an experiment. If you test any of the translations, please let me know what you think. I'm curious to hear your reactions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you! Have fun and enjoy your summer![/p]

notes.title: Chapter 10 development update II
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is hopefully the last development update before the release of Chapter 10. It took a while, but the chapter is finally nearing completion. I have to admit that I learned a lot while working on this chapter, especially in terms of what NOT to do, haha. But as they say, all's well that ends well. And I'm pleased with the results, if I do say so myself.

Attached to this post are some teaser previews, and as usual, there may be some mild spoilers, so be careful.

I know some of you are [b]very[/b] impatient by now, the anticipation is almost palpable 😅 I was really hoping to be done in April, but unfortunately that didn't happen. But I'm fairly sure that Chapter 10 will arrive in May (unless I get hit by a meteor or some other cataclysmic event). Please bear with me, we're almost there!

notes.title: Thank you and post-launch thoughts
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been almost a week since Gynocracy launched in Early Access and I'm very humbled by the response so far, thank you all very much.
I'd like to take this opportunity to clarify some frequently raised issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/90d21267b1f5a1c1f7f372170d73a8a7003bdf27.png[/img]

[h1]Release of new chapters[/h1]
Each chapter takes about two months to produce. Chapter 4 was completed in August. Chapter 5 is currently about 50% done, so you should expect it to be [b]available in late October/early November[/b]. Please keep in mind that this is a single-dev project and things outside my control can happen, so don't take this as set in stone, but this is the general idea.


[h1]Localization[/h1]
Will the game be translated into [insert your favorite language]? I can't say yet. I would like the game translated into as many languages as possible, but only [b]after it comes out of Early Access[/b]. The reason for this is that localization would complicate the release of new chapters at this stage + I want to be able to easily tweak existing chapters as needed.


[h1]Game choices, paths[/h1]
The first three chapters are fairly linear to establish the game world and story. In chapter 4, things start to diverge based on your choices. These divergences [b]revolve around the main couple[/b], the protagonist and his wife. The changes are subtle at first, but the idea is to make them deeper and deeper. From the feedback I've gotten so far, there are a lot of different expectations for how our heroes' relationship should evolve, so I want to let the players decide.


[h1]Steam Reviews[/h1]
If you have played the game, [b]please, please, please consider writing a review[/b] ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamthumbsdownː. So far, only a tiny fraction of players have left a review. In addition to providing feedback to the developers, reviews affect the visibility of the game on Steam and are therefore extremely important, especially for small indie games like Gynocracy.


[h1]Feedback[/h1]
I want to hear your feedback! Tell me what you liked, what you didn't like, what you'd like to see more of (or less of). Even though I have the whole story outlined, I'm not afraid to change things based on player feedback :)

Thank you and have fun!
